longForm.heroHook: One condenser reaches its limit. The second one takes over automatically.
longForm.heroLead: One Freeze Dryer. Multiple Researchers. Zero Waiting on the Condenser. Shared lab freeze dryers rarely get a break. One researcher is finishing a long cycle, another is waiting to start, and a condenser reaching capacity can bring the whole workflow to a halt. TriEpic’s INFINITY double-condenser option keeps things moving. When one condenser reaches maximum capacity, the second takes over automatically — allowing the freeze-drying cycle to continue without a manual reset or a lost run. With up to 30 kg condenser capacity and 16 kg/24 h active condensing capacity, INFINITY is built for busy, shared laboratories handling multiple projects, formats and cycles.

sections.title: Product Information

body.text: Ice condenser capacity reaches up to 30 kg, with 16 kg processed every 24 hours, sized for demanding multi-format or high-volume freeze-drying work.
The INFINITY double-condenser option alternates automatically once the active condenser reaches capacity, sustaining continuous cycles instead of forcing a stop-and-reset between runs.
Condenser temperature runs at -55°C or -85°C as standard, with -105°C available as an upgrade for products that need it.
Electrically heated shelves are available as an add-on for temperature-controlled primary drying.
A single-compressor and dual-compressor version both exist, at 2,500 W and 3,500 W respectively, letting the electrical footprint match the configuration chosen.
Vacuum control is available as an option, useful for labs optimizing cycle time rather than running fixed protocols.
A chemical solvent condenser, capacitive vacuum probe, and ultra-low GWP natural refrigerants are all available to match specific process or sustainability requirements.
SCADA software supporting FDA 21 CFR Part 11 data acquisition is available for labs that need documented, audit-ready cycle records.

body: A single condenser reaching its capacity mid-run forces a choice: stop and reset, or lose the batch.
INFINITY's second condenser takes over automatically the moment the first reaches its limit, so the cycle keeps running without operator intervention.
For labs where several researchers rotate through the same machine on different schedules, that removes the scheduling friction of "wait until the condenser clears."
The result functions less like a single-run freeze dryer and more like a continuously available shared resource.

body: Shrinking a freeze dryer usually means losing precision along with the size. LyoLab Mini keeps the exact production characteristics of the full LyoLab, just packed into a smaller frame.

That matters most at the recipe development stage: a cycle validated on LyoLab Mini behaves the same way when it moves to a full-scale LyoLab, because the underlying control software and thermal system are shared, not approximated.
Fluid recirculation drives that consistency directly, heating and cooling trays with the same accuracy a production-scale system relies on.

items: Recipe development often needs to happen under the same conditions the final product will face. Clean-room integration, sterile handling, and documented cycles are all available as configuration options rather than separate equipment purchases.
A paneled front supports direct clean-room integration, while CIP and VHP sanitization options handle in-place cleaning without disassembly.
Pneumatic vials stoppering and a bottle manifold support different container formats within the same unit.
Eutectic point and nucleation control give finer command over the freezing step itself, useful for formulations sensitive to how ice forms.
Ethernet connectivity enables remote monitoring, and wireless temperature probes plus a capacitive pressure sensor add finer real-time process visibility.

faqs.question: What is the LyoLab used for?
faqs.answer: It's a pilot freeze dryer built for developing freeze-drying recipes ahead of production scale-up, and for producing small, non-aseptic batches of high-value product directly.

faqs.question: How does LyoLab support production scale-up?
faqs.answer: It runs the same base software as Dara-Lyo's production equipment, so a recipe developed on LyoLab transfers directly to full-scale manufacturing.

faqs.question: What shelf configurations are available?
faqs.answer: 3+1 shelves at 0.49 m² useful area, or 6+1 shelves at 0.98 m², both using 370 x 445 mm shelf sizing.

faqs.question: What condenser capacity does LyoLab offer?
faqs.answer: 10 kg standard, with an optional upgrade to 20 kg (15 kg/24h) for heavier loads.

faqs.question: What temperature range do the shelves support?
faqs.answer: From -60°C up to +80°C, covering deep-freeze and elevated-temperature drying in the same unit.

faqs.question: Does LyoLab support data acquisition?
faqs.answer: Yes, additional configuration options add documented data acquisition for traceable development cycles.

faqs.question: Can LyoLab be used for real production, not just development?
faqs.answer: Yes, it's designed to run small, non-aseptic batches of high-added-value products directly, alongside its recipe development role.

faqs.question: What is the price of LyoLab in India?
faqs.answer: Get in touch and Inkarp will put together a quote based on the shelf, condenser, and optional equipment configuration needed.

faqs.question: Who is the authorized distributor of LyoLab in India?
faqs.answer: Inkarp is the authorized distributor and service provider for the Dara-Lyo LyoLab in India, providing demonstration, installation, training, AMC, spare parts, and technical support.

longForm.heroHook: Develop the recipe here. Run it unchanged at production scale.
longForm.heroLead: Control and precision were the whole design brief behind LyoLab. It runs the same base software as full production equipment, so a recipe built here isn't a rough draft, it's the actual protocol that carries forward. LyoLab is built for two jobs at once: developing freeze-drying recipes ahead of production scale-up, and running real, small non-aseptic batches of high-value product in the meantime. Condenser capacity reaches up to 20 kg with the optional upgrade, shelf temperature spans -60°C to +80°C, and stainless steel AISI 316L contact parts keep it built to pharma-grade standards throughout.

sections.title: Product Information

body.text: LyoLab runs the same base software as Dara-Lyo's production freeze dryers, so a cycle developed here transfers directly, not approximately, to full-scale manufacturing.
Two shelf configurations are available: 3+1 shelves at 0.49 m² useful area, or 6+1 shelves at 0.98 m², both using 370 x 445 mm shelf sizing.
Standard condenser capacity is 10 kg, processing 8 kg every 24 hours, with an optional upgrade to 20 kg capacity at 15 kg/24h for heavier development or production loads.
Condenser temperature runs to -85°C standard, extendable to -105°C, and shelf temperature spans a wide -60°C to +80°C range in one unit.
Product contact parts are stainless steel AISI 316L throughout, matching the material standard production equipment requires.
Additional configuration options support systems with data acquisition, useful for labs that need documented, traceable development cycles.
Beyond recipe development, LyoLab handles genuine production runs of small, non-aseptic, high-added-value batches directly.

body: A recipe is only as useful as its ability to survive the jump to production. LyoLab closes that gap by running the same base software full production equipment uses, not a scaled-down approximation of it.
That means a cycle validated on LyoLab behaves the same way when it moves to a full production line, because the control logic isn't being translated between two different systems.
The same unit also runs real production batches directly, small, non-aseptic, high-value runs that don't need a separate machine just because they're not full-scale yet.

items: Development cycles that need to be defended later need to be documented now. Additional configuration options bring data acquisition into the standard workflow rather than bolting it on afterward.
A paneled front supports clean-room integration, and CIP with VHP sanitization options handle in-place cleaning without disassembly.
Pneumatic vials stoppering and a bottle manifold support different container formats within the same unit.
Eutectic point and nucleation control give finer command over the freezing step, useful for formulations sensitive to how ice forms.
Ethernet connectivity enables remote monitoring, and wireless temperature probes plus a capacitive pressure sensor add real-time process visibility.
An organic solvent condenser protects the main system when formulations involve solvents.
